_meta.title: Joint angular-velocity channels (deg/s) derived from public_joint_trajectories_110plus.json
_meta.status: DERIVED from SYNTHETIC curves (finite difference of angle_deg). NOT measured. Only the cited peak speeds/timings are published; the shape between them is the generator's construction.
_meta.method: velocity_deg_s = np.gradient(angle_deg, t_s) on the 10 ms grid. A 10 ms grid smears sharp peaks, so the finite-difference peak is slightly below the analytic generator speed (kept as generator_speed_deg_s for comparison; see max_fd_vs_generator_deg_s).
_meta.sign: Signed d(angle)/dt of the channel as defined in the trajectory file (rotation: + toward target / open; arm-to-trunk and elbow flexion decrease in the downswing so their velocity is negative; wrist set angle increases = uncocking = positive). speed_deg_s is |velocity|.

time_axis.note: t < -T_downswing is the end of the backswing: angle HELD at the top keyframe (extrapolation, not published). t > 0 is follow-through: speed decays exponentially with tau=0.05 s (ASSUMED). Published support exists ONLY for -T_downswing <= t <= 0.

_meta.left_handed_mirror_rule: velocities mirror like their angle channels: negate pelvis/thorax/x_factor, no change for planar channels (see docs/HANDEDNESS.md and the trajectory file).
_meta.extrapolation_warning: 120 and 130 mph classes extrapolate beyond published support (see trajectory file); 130 mph especially.
